[4] Goose Adversary Mode Documentation. goose-docs.ai.
https://goose-docs.ai/docs/guides/security/adversary-mode/
Independent agent reviewer watching tool calls before execution. Three-step process (analyze, decide ALLOW/BLOCK, enforce). Fail-open design. Plain-language security rules in ~/.config/goose/adversary.md. Default scope: shell and computercontroller tools. Uses same model/provider as main agent.

## Security Research

[14] Block Engineering. "How We Red-Teamed Our Own AI Agent." January 15, 2026.
https://engineering.block.xyz/blog/how-we-red-teamed-our-own-ai-agent-
Operation Pale Fire. Three campaigns: calendar injection (failed, rate limits), poisoned recipe at live presentation (typo prevented), direct social engineering to developer (succeeded). Unicode smuggling with zero-width characters. Infostealer payload. Remediation: recipe visualization, Unicode filtering, prompt injection detection, telemetry improvements. Authors: Josiah Peedikayil, Wes Ring.

[15] Veria Labs. "Securing Open Source Part 1: Block Goose." March 24, 2026.
https://verialabs.com/blog/securing-open-source-part-1-block-goose/
Critical 1-click RCE via CSWSH in web mode. No CVE assigned. Server accepted all requests without credentials, wildcard CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). Two-way interaction: "persistent, invisible C2 channel." Timeline: discovered 11/21/2025, reported 11/22/2025, fixed 11/23/2025, web mode removed in v1.25.0 (PR #7696, 03/06/2026). Researchers: Jayden and Cayden.

[16] Red Canary. "MCP AI Workflows Threat Detection." 2026.
https://redcanary.com/blog/threat-detection/mcp-ai-workflows/
MCP threat vectors: data exposure, model hijacking, unauthorized access. MCP lacks built-in security mechanisms. Treat as "untrusted application." *Note: article does not provide quantitative SSRF rates or server counts as initially reported by counter-discovery agent.*

[17] Instagit. "How Goose Implements Prompt Injection Detection and Security Filtering."
https://instagit.com/block/goose/goose-prompt-injection-detection-security-filtering/
Security pipeline: pattern matching + ML classification. SecurityManager orchestrates inspection of tool calls before execution.

[18] Nudge Security. "MCP Security Risks: Exposure and Best Practices." 2026.
https://www.nudgesecurity.com/post/mcp-security-risks-mcp-server-exposure-and-best-practices-for-the-ai-agent-era
MCP operates within authorized access bounds making detection difficult. Authorized OAuth tokens can be used for exfiltration.

[19] The Register. "Anthropic MCP Design Flaw." April 16, 2026.
https://www.theregister.com/2026/04/16/anthropic_mcp_design_flaw/
